##### SECTION EP (encryption, keystatus, encryptionroot, keyformat, keylocation on fs and snapshot, before/after unload-key)  tag=C  zfs-2.3.9-0+deb13u1
=== CASE EP/00_fs_loaded
--- cmd
zfs get -H -o name,property,value,source encryption,keystatus,encryptionroot,keyformat,keylocation zfsbcapc/EP/e
--- rc
0
--- stdout
zfsbcapc/EP/e	encryption	aes-256-gcm	-
zfsbcapc/EP/e	keystatus	available	-
zfsbcapc/EP/e	encryptionroot	zfsbcapc/EP/e	-
zfsbcapc/EP/e	keyformat	passphrase	-
zfsbcapc/EP/e	keylocation	file:///var/tmp/zfsb-matrix/cap.key1	local
--- stderr
=== END
